caption:
SpaceX just flew a booster to the edge of space and brought it back, and this footage captures the whole fall.

These boosters separate after launch, flip around mid-air, and fire their engines just enough to land upright. Every successful landing saves tens of millions of dollars by reusing hardware that used to be thrown in the ocean. This was science fiction ten years ago.
